intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}, but our table is thin on fees and placements for this comparison. This page says clearly what we hold, and what you should confirm on official sites opened in {{year}}.
College of Engineering Trivandrum vs SCTCE for M.Tech should not be decided from empty package cells. CET lists many M.Tech branches; SCTCE has a generic M.Tech row and a GATE mapping.

sections.heading: CET Thiruvananthapuram vs SCTCE for M.Tech / M.E.: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose College of Engineering Trivandrum if you want a wider listed M.Tech set, including structural, environmental, geotechnical, industrial and computer science programmes, after you get the official fee circular.
Choose SCTCE if you want a public M.Tech in the same city and will apply through the GATE route listed on our records, again after you confirm the official fee and the exact branch.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what is missing
paragraphs: Neither college has an M.Tech fee row in our table. A blank cell is not a free degree. Use the official postgraduate fee notices on cet.ac.in and sctce.ac.in.
Kerala government M.Tech fees are usually modest compared with private universities, but the exact amount depends on the current circular and any sponsored or self-financing seat.
Do not borrow the undergraduate fee rows from the B.Tech comparison and treat them as M.Tech totals.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We have no M.Tech placement row for 2020 or later on either side, so this page cannot quote an average or highest package.
Ask both placement cells for a recent M.Tech or GATE-recruitment report. Undergraduate 2023 figures from the B.Tech page should not be reused here.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: SCTCE is listed with GATE. CET has no exam mapped on this M.Tech page, so follow its official postgraduate admissions note, which in Kerala often also uses GATE.
CET lists many named M.Tech branches. SCTCE has a generic M.Tech row. Confirm the exact specialisation and seat type on the official form.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Thiruvananthapuram, so travel across the city is the main location question.
CET is the larger government engineering college, with a longer listed M.Tech branch list on this page. SCTCE is also public, but our table shows less programme detail.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick CET if the named M.Tech branch you want is listed there and the official fee circular is acceptable.
Pick SCTCE if that campus and the listed GATE route fit you, after you have the official branch and fee in hand.
Because fees and placements are missing here, do not let empty table cells decide this comparison.

faqs.question: What M.Tech fees are on record for CET and SCTCE?
faqs.answer: None on this page. Both fee cells are empty. Use the official postgraduate fee notices on cet.ac.in and sctce.ac.in, and do not reuse B.Tech figures.

faqs.question: Are M.Tech placements available for comparison?
faqs.answer: No. We have no 2020 or later M.Tech placement row for either college. Ask the placement cells for a recent report.

faqs.question: Which exam do these M.Tech programmes use?
faqs.answer: SCTCE is listed with GATE. CET has no exam mapped on this page, so follow its official postgraduate admissions note.

faqs.question: Does CET list more M.Tech branches than SCTCE?
faqs.answer: On this page, yes. CET lists many named M.Tech programmes. SCTCE has a generic M.Tech row, so confirm the exact branch on the official form.

faqs.question: Are both colleges public institutions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded as public engineering colleges in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

faqs.question: Should I use the B.Tech comparison numbers here?
faqs.answer: No. Undergraduate fees and 2023 B.Tech packages should not be treated as M.Tech figures. Confirm the official M.Tech notice.
